description: The Composition — the whole page as one Mondrian canvas. Thick black grid lines divide every band into asymmetric cells; a few planes painted primary red, blue, and yellow, the rest broken white. A painted navigation band with a black counterweight void, a featured plane beside a generative date-seeded De Stijl composition (click to re-compose), posts as cells that flood with their section's primary on hover, and a red reading rule that extends across the top as you scroll. Space Grotesk lowercase structure, Inter reading plane. No curves anywhere.
